newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it raised the price it would pay for some grades of crude oil by C$4.00/cubic metre or C$0.64/barrel, effective immediately.
The new prices were listed as follows:
Edmonton light sweet C$168.00/cubic metre, or C$26.71/barrel
Cromer light sour C$156.00/cubic metre, or C$24.80/barrel
Bow River at Hardisty C$128.00/cubic metre, or C$20.35/barrel
Midale at Cromer C$139.00/cubic metre, or C$22.10/barrel
